source.title: Launch RoamWise Weddings MVP — Kumaon venues, artists, transport & qualified leads
source.body:
## Goal
Launch **RoamWise Weddings** as a lead-generation and verified-vendor vertical alongside Stay & Do, not a destructive travel pivot. Prioritize Uttarakhand/Kumaon initial supply (Almora, Ranikhet, Bhimtal, Nainital, Corbett), then expand India-wide.

## MVP (reversible, behind feature flag)
- Homepage prominent Weddings CTA and /weddings landing page with responsive RoamWise purple/gold and Kumaoni/Aipan visual styling.
- 2 entry paths: **Plan a Wedding** and **List Wedding Services** (reuse existing partner onboarding and admin review).
- Wedding enquiry: location, date(s), guest count, rooms, budget range, functions, transport origin, accessibility, contact/consent. WhatsApp-first or form submission with backend logging and spam controls.
- Wedding vendors: venue, photographer, makeup, mehndi/Aipan, live music, officiant, decor, caterer, guest transportation, gifts.
- Distinguish **verified wedding-ready** from existing RoamWise stays; do NOT auto-label hotels as wedding-ready without capacity, event permission, pricing and owner consent.
- Venue cards: rooms, guest capacity, lawn/banquet, indoor rain backup, parking, road access, music cutoff, accessibility, noise limits, indicative prices, cancellation/deposit and GST disclosure where applicable.
- Vendor match with human approval. Ailon Tusk should collect brief, create budget ranges with assumptions, show only verified offers, route quote requests, maintain enquiry state. Never hallucinate availability or accept payments without valid backend integration.
- Admin CRM for lead sources, unique enquiry IDs, consent, status, owner, quote response SLA, deposits, revenue/commission, disputes. Scoped staff access; founder final approval.
- Start as lead/referral model; no involuntary payment collection and no dependency on Cashfree production until sandbox webhook/reconciliation/idempotency checks pass.
- Add schema.org metadata, wedding SEO destinations pages, analytics funnel visit -> lead -> qualified -> venue quote -> booking -> gross margin.
- Include wedding-day traffic and shuttle coordination; small curated celebrations as signature offering.

## Commercial model (proposed; negotiate separately)
Venue commission 5–8% where signed; vendor referral 8–12% where signed; transport 5–10% margin; planning coordination fee quoted transparently. No double-charging; written vendor/referral terms and clear customer pricing, T&Cs, cancellation, GST.
Existing stay commission terms remain unchanged until signed amendment.

## Acceptance / testing
- Mobile Android Chrome (Moto G64), desktop, keyboard/screen-reader basics.
- End-to-end submitted lead appears in admin, is deduped, can be assigned, followed up, closed, and exported without leaking personal information.
- Wedding vendor onboarding needs photo permissions, owner consent, verification status, and ability to upload real images.
- No fake testimonials, fabricated prices, unsupported inventory or automatic claims of partnerships.
- Feature flag OFF by default until smoke tests and founder review; no production write or live charge without separate approval.

## Launch KPI
30-day goal: 20 verified suppliers, 30 qualified leads, >=5 signed quote requests, >=1 confirmed paid booking, measured verified net contribution, with acquisition spend capped.

## Addendum: lawful sourcing and vendor non-response playbook (1 Nov 2026)

**Important:** WedMeGood Terms last updated March 2026 §9.3 prohibit copying/scraping, data mining/bots without permission and using platform content to build competing services. DO NOT import their database, images, reviews, prices or content. Their directory may inform manual market research; verify all supplier facts independently via official venue sites/owner submissions. Consider requesting a licensed commercial data partnership with vendors@wedmegood.com.

### Vendor acquisition without status games
- Zero mandatory listing fees during pilot, no exclusivity, no guaranteed leads.
- Default private prospect CRM; publish branded vendor pages only with permission and verified facts/assets.
- Distinguish prospect -> contacted -> owner consent -> verified -> active -> responsive -> booking-ready. Make clear to users when no agreement exists.
- One-page mobile onboarding: property name, management contact, guest/event capacity, 6 owner-approved photos, event availability, indicative quote, written consent; staff can assist over WhatsApp.
- Outreach from concrete qualified wedding brief; decision-maker focus (GM/owner/banquet/event sales). Two courteous follow-ups then park lead 60 days; do not spam.
- SLA: acknowledgement <4 business hours for active vendors, quote within 24 hours; fallback to next responsive vendor. No false scarcity/guarantees.
- Admin response metrics, auto-reminders, consent timestamps, expiry/re-verification, pause unreliable venues.
- Prove business: provide customer briefing, transparent commissions agreed in writing, booking attribution, payout cadence, cancellation/refund policy. Respect existing 7% Milan Heights agreement; wedding terms require amendment.
- Lead quality and privacy: OTP or fraud checks, privacy notice/consent for sharing with providers, minimum data access. No third-party scraping of personal phone numbers.
- Pilot target: 10 directly verified wedding-ready vendors and 2 wedding quote requests before paid marketing. Track response rate, quote time, qualified lead to booking conversion.
- Differentiation: compact curated weddings, cultural artists, guest overflow stays, shuttles; avoid unsupported 'verified' badge.

Competitor reference: https://www.wedmegood.com/terms and https://www.wedmegood.com/vendors/jim-corbett/wedding-venues/ (research only; no data ingestion).
